test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LNS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0acc53e624758c4fadebbbf1b48934418f965b39ebc31c02f53ac95a85c0c27.png] 

Option 2) SUZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/584b9404326f8103db1cf5c3817a3d1ef976118d8e0f06a00c99615cbf8ad16b.png] 

Option 3) MOT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96fe3501297e14a7ae9ea916f7b161de7dd0a920657363c1d00672b600c362bd.png] 

Option 4) DFO​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53eb71d01eed2087ac1bec227d3f2a748182eca7e2a3df0c9126008e2a59b645.png] 

Thus, out of all 'DFO' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
